text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The history of Funabashi Racecourse. Once 
upon a time, right next to it... there was 
a hot spring facility.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet it has closed down and is no longer 
there. If that is the case, let us journey 
forth in search of hot springs.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, it's finally time, isn't it? Our 
reward hot springs trip.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
The most I usually ever go to is a public 
bathhouse, so I am looking forward to 
this, very much!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wanting to enjoy the unique water quality 
straight from the source for a change, the 
two of them happily set off.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, that was a wonderful bath. How 
should I put it...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I feel warmed right to the core. So this 
is... the power of hot springs...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Or if such a hot spring had always existed 
right beside Funabashi Racecourse...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Things might have been a little different. 
My situation, that is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In pursuing our racing careers, Furioso 
and I had a quiet struggle that was kept 
from the public eye.
choice_data_list: Then... will you show me your legs?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Yes, the usual, please.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
What do you think? Has the swelling gone 
down a bit?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, must be the hot spring's healing 
effects.

Yeah, must be the healing effects of the 
hot spring.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Furioso's legs swell easily. However, 
soaking in the hot springs seems to have 
had a good effect.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still, we can't let our guard down. I'll 
apply some light, routine treatment.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Pssssshhhhh...)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Thank you... very much. This... feels so 
soothing...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
My Trainer's care is truly thorough, and 
on top of that, they're always coming up 
with creative ways to help me...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
There is no one else who would care for me 
so attentively. Thanks to that...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I'm managing to run. Because you came 
along with me on my special study abroad, 
I'm somehow still keeping at it today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Furioso's legs aren't particularly sturdy. 
Being such a hard worker only makes the 
physical toll on her legs that much 
higher.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The symptoms vary each time, so the same 
approach won't work. In that case...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I just have to adapt my approach each 
time. Every single time is a small 
invention. Even so...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
They had somehow pulled it off. This, too, 
was only possible because they were from 
the same hometown and knew each other 
inside out.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer understands me very well. 
However...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I feel like your care is so good not just 
because it's me you're looking after.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps you have a talent for it. A 
talent for getting an out-of-form 
Umamusume back on her feet...?"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer themselves might just be a person 
akin to a hot spring.
choice_data_list: I see, a walking hot spring, huh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe someday in the future, I might be 
praised as a trainer who runs a miraculous 
rehabilitation workshop."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I look forward to working with 
you from now on. Please continue to 
support me.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: And then...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I'd love for you to take me to the hot 
springs again. I believe delicious food 
and fun conversation are just as 
necessary, after all.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Wherever we go, the two of us together... 
As long as we're together...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"That place... is home. Because being 
there makes me feel like I never left."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond with Furioso...
